messages.subject: Effects coding specified manually?
parts:
Is there something wrong with equality constraints when a coefficient is fixed? I can request effects coding in this example and it works fine. But when I try to create effects coding manually, I get loadings fixed to 1 and nonsense.

## Load lavaan package
library("lavaan")

## Copy in correlation matrix as string
Rigstr<-' 1.00
  0.57  1.00
 0.44  0.41  1.00
 0.29  0.27  0.15  1.00
 0.53  0.51  0.44  0.23  1.00
 0.42  0.39  0.36  0.17  0.72  1.00
 0.47  0.30  0.26  0.05  0.32  0.29  1.00
 0.29  0.23  0.13 -0.03  0.24  0.17  0.51  1.00
 0.40  0.11  0.17 -0.03  0.04  0.04  0.30  0.24  1.00
 0.40  0.28  0.18 -0.03  0.26  0.25  0.73  0.60  0.36  1.00
-0.08 -0.07 -0.04 -0.41 -0.11 -0.06  0.13  0.17  0.12  0.16  1.00
 0.06  0.05  0.00 -0.32 -0.03  0.02  0.18  0.21  0.16  0.23  0.74  1.00 '
 
## Use getCov() to turn string into a correlation matrix (data)
Rigcor<-getCov(Rigstr,names=c('q3', 'q4', 'q5', 'q2', 'q1', 'q6', 'q7a', 'q7c', 'q7d', 'q7f', 'q9', 'q10'))
   
# enter lavaan model syntax as a string
     
Rigmod<-'# Factor - Factor
 satisfac ~ servqual + value
 value ~ price + satisfac
 loyalty ~ satisfac + value
 
# Factor - Indicator
# sem function defaults fix first loading to 1
servqual =~ q7a + q7c + q7d + q7f
price =~ q9 + q10
satisfac =~ q3 + q4 + q5
value =~ q2
loyalty =~ q1 + q6
 
# Special conditions
q2 ~~ 0.20*q2'
   
## Use effects coding to scale the common factors
## Short method
Rigmod.outEC <- sem(model=Rigmod,sample.cov=Rigcor,sample.nobs=275,effect.coding=T)
summary(Rigmod.outEC)

## Manual specification

RigmodEC<-'# Factor - Factor
 satisfac ~ servqual + value
 value ~ price + satisfac
 loyalty ~ satisfac + value
 
# Factor - Indicator
# sem function defaults fix first loading to 1
servqual =~ NA*q7a + a1*q7a + a2*q7c + a3*q7d + a4*q7f
price =~    NA*q9 + b1*q9 + b2*q10
satisfac =~ NA*q3 + c1*q3 + c2*q4 + c3*q5
value =~    d1*q2
loyalty =~  NA*e1 + e1*q1 + e2*q6
 
# Special conditions
q2 ~~ 0.20*q2

a1 == 4 - a2 - a3 - a4
b1 == 2 - b2
c1 == 3 - c2 - c3
d1 == 1
e1 == 2 - e2
'

Rigmod.outEC.long <- sem(model=RigmodEC,sample.cov=Rigcor,sample.nobs=275,auto.fix.first=F)
summary(Rigmod.outEC.long)

Here is the problem:

## Manual specification

RigmodEC<-'...
loyalty =~  NA*e1 ...

Should be NA*q1
